capabilities: Add files and expandable folders to a quick access list
Track recently opened and recently created files
Rank files by open counts over the last seven days and all time
Configure entries per section and hide unused sections
disambiguation: Quick Access items exist only inside this dashboard; they do not pin Obsidian tabs or modify the Bookmarks core feature.
extras: Current release is a beta requiring Obsidian 1.13.0+ on desktop; mobile support is not yet validated.
problem: Obsidian has no single sidebar that combines hand-pinned files with automatic recent and open-frequency tracking of files and folders.
summary: Sidebar dashboard that gathers pinned files and folders, recently opened, recently created, and most-opened files in one place.
